simple.meaning: גֵּזֶל (gêzel) is a Hebrew word meaning “plunder , i.e. violence.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: גֵּזֶל (H1499) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Ecclesiastes 5:7, with occurrences in Ecclesiastes, Ezekiel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to גֵּזֶל (H1499) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in גֵּזֶל (H1499) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: גֵּזֶל (gêzel) / H1499 is traced through Ecclesiastes 5:7, Ezekiel 18:18 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
